description: Job: adjacent shots -> seam findings (the seam check of SPEC_19 R17, given the frame captions a vision pass writes). Each case plants errors (and, in two cases, none) between a shot's last frame and the next shot's first frame, and lists the differences that are justified by the shot text so that flagging them counts as invented.

cases.title: Tears vanish and the jacket opens between two continuous close-ups

difficulty.emotion: a man crying through the seam
traps: heavier rain is justified by the next shot's text
the dry cheeks contradict the text that says he keeps crying
